correctness.rationale: For all M>1, 0<alpha<1, for the four-branch fixed-point-free affine map and the strict itinerary of exactly k outer positive steps/one positive inner/k outer negative/one negative inner, the exact half return is G_k(x)=M alpha^k x-M sum_{j=0}^k alpha^j and full return H_k(x)=(M alpha^k)^2 x+M S_k(1-M alpha^k). For M alpha^k!=1 the unique fixed point X_k= M S_k/(1+M alpha^k) has strict itinerary exactly iff q_k=Σ_{j=1}^{k-1}alpha^-j<M-1. At M alpha^k=1 and q_k<M-1, the return is identity on J_k=(M(S_k-1),M), a continuum of exact least period 2(k+1) cycles. Otherwise its stability multiplier is (M alpha^k)^2. Monotonicity of q_k gives k<M cutoff, exact M=5 birth thresholds and exactly two attracting windows (k=1, alpha<1/5; k=2, 1/4<alpha<1/sqrt5). Independently iterated five strict cycles and 21 neutral sample points across three (M,k) pairs, including M=5 neutral windows. Finite trajectories are checks of the exact affine-return algebra, not a global period census. Boundaries and zero are explicitly excluded.
